Name: Corpus Blob Pusher
Description: Blob data-plane read/write/add WITHOUT delete. The minimum needed to sign a racwl user-delegation SAS (a user-delegation SAS is capped by the signer's RBAC at request time, so the signer must hold every action the SAS grants -- and no more). Deliberately omits blobs/delete and blobs/move/action so the holder can never destroy client corpus data.
